facts.value: students must first receive a SEVIS number and I-20 document from ASU
Your ASURITE User ID is the official login name you’ll use to access most ASU systems and services.
After you enroll in classes, visit asu.edu/emailsignup to activate your official @asu.edu email address.
Pay your enrollment deposit through My ASU to confirm you will attend.
All first-year students are required to take the math placement test at least seven calendar days before their Academic Orientation Session.
Through My ASU Parent Guest Access, you can share your academic records with your parent or guardian and give them access to pay your tuition and bills.
